[engine] Treat the output of a rate-limited assertion as a SAMPLE, never a census: it cannot support any statement of the form 'only layers X and Y are affected'.

<!-- generated by harness_engine/build_memories.py from traces/lessons.jsonl -->
<!-- lesson_id: eng-lf-0007 | class: log-forensics | superseded_by: - -->

**class**: `log-forensics`

## 為什麼（because）

CGC-MMID-ASSERT prints the first 8 violations verbatim and then only every 1000th. Ten printed lines were read as 'only layer 15 is affected' while the same log carried total=202000, i.e. an affected-layer set far larger than the printed sample.
